sites.name: KDP Coffee Roasting & K-Cup Plant - Spartanburg (Moore) SC
sites.dossierExcerpt:
The roster pin (34.870596, -82.032427, ROOFTOP) landed on a large white-roof
tilt-up warehouse along Moore Duncan Hwy (SC-290). Web research confirms this is
Building 500 at Tyger River Industrial Park (TRIP), the spec building where
Keurig Dr Pepper leased ~203,000 sq ft in September 2024 for next-generation
K-Rounds (plastic-free coffee pod) production as part of a $141M Spartanburg
County expansion (SC Dept of Commerce / SC Governor / Colliers releases). June
2025 Street View shows the completed building still carrying a Colliers
"for lease" leasing sign at the highway frontage, consistent with a recently
occupied spec building. The building runs NW-SE, roughly 600 ft long.

A separate large building with heavy dock/trailer activity sits to the SE on a
different parcel within the same park — it is NOT this facility and was excluded.

fieldNotes.location: Building 500, Tyger River Industrial Park (TRIP), 3220 Moore Duncan Hwy, Moore SC. KDP leased ~203,000 sq ft here Sept 2024 for next-gen K-Rounds production ($141M expansion). Confirmed via SC Commerce / Colliers releases and June 2025 Street View showing the spec building with a Colliers leasing sign.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open driveways at both NW and SE ends of the NE truck court connecting to the internal park road. No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate or checkpoint pinch-point visible in z20 satellite or June 2025 Street View. No perimeter fence around the property.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure at either truck-court access point in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long single bank of dock doors along the NE face; counted ~12-18 visible bays/trailers in z19 probes, full wall longer - banded 25-50 as a medium-confidence estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: NE truck court has marked trailer stalls but only a handful of trailers parked in available imagery (newly occupied building).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open truck court and two access points give ample room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Industrial park on the rural edge of Moore SC, surrounded by woods and farmland; broader setting is small-town/rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single KDP building. Two other large buildings sit in the same park (one to the SE with heavy trailer activity) but are separate facilities on separate parcels - not counted.
